newsitem.title: NIGER: 36 die after Niger desert sandstorm.
newsitem.headline: 36 die after Niger desert sandstorm.

text.p: At least 36 people died in the desert in Niger after a truck in which they were travelling lost its way in a sandstorm, military sources said on Friday.
Soldiers searching for the travellers, whose truck went missing on April 23 about 1,500 km (1,000 miles) northeast of the West African nation's capital Niamey, found eight survivors, they added.
The identity of the travellers, who left Dirkou for Agadez on April 21, was not immediately clear but they included nationals from other countries, said an army source.
The survivors had stayed with the truck. Most of those who died had left in search of help.
